shared_values: An F1 team works to a public sustainability plan: 100% sustainable fuel from 2026 and net zero by 2030. pH7 fits that plan directly: platinum, palladium and rhodium recovered from spent catalytic converters, in a closed loop, with no wastewater.
market_reference: Tenneco, whose Clean Air and Walker businesses make the catalysts and converters that become your feedstock, joined the Cadillac team as Official Technical Partner in January. The front end of your supply chain is in the sport; the platinum group metals seat next to it is open.
